quote: Explicit editor refactors preserve evaluation order, coldness, types, comments and declaration output.

samples.source: import { Effect } from "effect"; export function make(input: { value: number }): Effect.Effect<number> { const snapshot = input.value; return Effect.gen(function* () { return snapshot }) }
import { Effect } from "effect"; export function make(input: { value: number }): Effect.Effect<number> { const { value: snapshot } = input; return Effect.gen(function* () { return snapshot }) }
import { Effect } from "effect"; export function make(input: { value: number }) { const snapshot = { ...input }; return Effect.gen(function* () { return snapshot }) }

retimed: import { Effect } from "effect"; export function make(input: { value: number }): Effect.Effect<number> { return Effect.gen(function* () { const snapshot = input.value; return snapshot }) }
